assets.name: bivaro-sidebar-flat
assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. EDIT TARGET: the referenced BIVARO app emblem. Keep the exact recognizable geometric B outer silhouette, proportions, stacked ledger leaves and diagonal cut. Make a sidebar-specific FLAT light logo for a deep forest-green (#06251F) sidebar. Replace all dark forest faces with a single solid warm white #F2F7F4 and make the diagonal stripe a single flat muted sage #9EBEAF. Remove all 3D depth, bevels, gradients, lighting, material texture and gloss. The mark must be clean, minimal, modern, fully flat vector-style geometry with crisp edges, readable at 28 pixels. Genuine transparent alpha outside the mark and in the cut gaps; do not add a backdrop or badge. Only ONE isolated mark, no words, no shadow, no border, no watermark.

assets.name: flat-incomes
assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a single transparent dashboard UI icon for BIVARO. Pure flat vector-style line pictogram, modern understated editorial software design. Use exactly ONE solid muted evergreen ink color #456F62, uniform medium-bold strokes, rounded line caps and carefully aligned geometry. Strokes roughly 6% of the symbol width. Only ONE pictogram, not a sheet. Subject: one simple arrow diagonally upward-right, with a short L-shaped baseline below it, incoming revenue.
